quests.name: Bad-Anon: Valley Chapter
objectives: Go inside Ralph' s House.
Talk to Ralph .
Talk to Scar .
Plant the Charity Flowers on the Sunlit Plateau . (5)
Water and gather the Charity Flowers on the Sunlit Plateau. (5)
Make sure you have the Community Flowers with you. (5)
Talk to Ursula .
Find Ursula's Seaweed Sachet buried near the willow tree in the Glade of Trust .

Gather the following Ingredients for Ursula's Community Brew :
  ‧ Garlic. Ginger. Vanilla. Mint. Seaweed Sachet.
Prepare Ursula's Community Brew at a Cooking Station.
Make sure you have Ursula's Community Brew in your Inventory.
Bring the Community Brew to Ursula .
Go inside Ralph's House .

The Do-Gooder Trophy is missing?!
  ‧ Talk to Ralph.
Search Ralph's House for clues about the identity of the trophy thief.
Talk to a Villager with blue fur about the missing Do-Gooder Trophy.
Confront Mother Gothel about the missing trophy.

Check the Dark Plaza for the Do-Gooder Trophy.
  ‧ (Remember: You can access this area through the Dark Portal in the Plaza.)
Extinguish the flowers to reach the Do-Gooder Trophy in the Dark Plaza. (5)
Rescue the Do-Gooder Trophy in the Dark Plaza.
Place the Do-Gooder Trophy in the Valley.
Take a photo with Ralph and the rescued Do-Gooder Trophy .
Debrief about the Bad-Anon meeting with Ralph .

quests.name: Mini-game Mayhem
objectives: Talk to Tiana .
Bring the Dessert Contest Cakes to Ralph's House .
Put the Dessert Contest Cakes on the display in Ralph's House .
Take a picture of the eating contest!
Talk to Ralph in his House about the contest.
Catch any fish for Ralph's fishing mini-game.
Listen to Vanellope 's conversation with Ralph .
Ask Peter Pan for a fun game idea.

Collect materials for Ralph's Scavenger Hunt Ads :
  ‧ Dark Wood. (6) Vitalys Crystal. (5) Glass. (4) Gold Ingot. (2) Tinkering Parts. Arcade Pixel.
Build Ralph's Scavenger Hunt Ad at a Crafting Station. (4)
Place Ralph's Scavenger Hunt Ads around Dreamlight Valley. (4)
Talk to Ralph .
Enter Skull Rock to begin the scavenger hunt.

Find three buried treasures to win the scavenger hunt:
  ‧ First Treasure, near the pile of gold. Second Treasure, near the stairs. Third Treasure, near the bridge.
Show the treasures to Ralph at the top of Skull Rock.

quests.name: Green Monster, Inc.
objectives:
Gather Ingredients for an Atomically Spicy Joyful Meal :
  ‧ Wheat. Raspberry. Blueberry. Banana. SUPER Spicy Chili Pepper.
Cook an Atomically Spicy Joyful Meal .
Make sure you have the Atomically Spicy Joyful Meal in your Inventory.
Bring the Atomically Spicy Joyful Meal to Ralph .

Head to the Dreamscape to check on the picnic with Ralph .
  ‧ (Remember: You can reach the Dreamscape via the Tree House in the Forgotten Lands.)
Vanellope and Sulley are trying the spicy meal. Listen in...
Ask The Forgotten for guidance about dark stuff.

Go inside the Dark Castle .
  ‧ (Hint: Visit the Dark Castle through the portal in the Plaza!)
Complete the Puzzle Orb in the Dark Castle .
Talk to Ralph .
Talk to Ralph in Dreamlight Valley .

Gather materials to build Vanellope's surprise :
  ‧ Dry Wood. (20) Iron Ore. (15) Glass. (10) Diamond. Arcade Pixel.
Craft Vanellope's surprise at a Crafting Station .
Place the Double Dance Arcade Machine in the Valley.
Look at the Double Dance Arcade Machine !
Talk to Ralph .

quests.name: Ralph Breaks the Valley
objectives: Go inside Ralph's House to see what he broke.
Catch the Cherries inside Ralph's House .
Pick up the Memory inside Ralph's House.
Talk to Ralph about the Memory .

Gather Ingredients for a Fix-It Pickaxe Enchantment :
  ‧ Dream Shard. (5) Night Shard. (5) Cheerful Cherry. (3)
Craft the Fix-It Pickaxe Enchantment :
Use the Fix-It Pickaxe Enchantment from your Inventory.
Visit the first House in the Memory to fix its glitches with your Pickaxe .
Collect the Memory in Tiana's House .
Visit the second House in the Memory to fix its glitches with your Pickaxe .
Collect the Memory in Alice's House .
Visit the third House in the Memory to fix its glitches with your Pickaxe .
Collect the Cheery Cherry in Peter Pan's Hideout .
Talk to Ralph about your progress.
Return to Ralph's House .
Return the Cheery Cherries to Coding Magically for N0v1ces in Ralph's House.
Talk to Ralph
